changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A trial is an item review with origin TRIAL that a workspace admin requests. It keeps its outcome in its report and never writes a result (ADR 0118 decision 8).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The database refuses a result for a trial review (ADR 0118 decision 8).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Trial retention finds the reports to clear without scanning every review.
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_review_trial_report; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_review_trial_report ON review (completed_at) WHERE origin='TRIAL' AND report IS NOT NULL

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_review_trial_report
